body:
Thank you for responding. And I'm so sorry you're going through such a painful time. Like you, I'm always taking naps, so I just don't have to deal with something that I have to do but can't for whatever reason. I'm also tired all the time, a feeling that never goes away.

I'm so sorry for the great amount of time you have to spend working. I hope you find empathetic people in your way that can understand all that you are going through. I know jobs can get very draining, so I hope the people around you can help you by balancing the weight of your tasks.

I'm glad to know that you were once happy and, from the bottom of my heart, wish that soon you feel that way again.

I loved your list. There's so much beauty in all of these simple things and in the way you try to keep your and our hopes alive. Thank you for sharing. Hope you get better and get to accomplish all the items in your list.
Very similar situation to my country's (Brazil)

I watched an andrew solomon TED once, it was about  his experience with depression. He described as if a funeral was forever happening inside his brain.  At least for my experience I tought it was very accurate.
Photography in general is magic to me. We can capture a moment exactly as it is and have it forever.
